fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Wheeled mechanized platoons in FWLM service ride armored personnel carriers that offer good road speed and reasonable protection, making them well-suited to the League's developed industrial worlds where paved infrastructure supports rapid deployment between population centers. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire at close range, these platoons trade precision for volume, putting enough rounds downrange to suppress enemy positions and deny open ground to advancing troops.
